name: Concourse
tagline: AI agents for finance teams — chat with your data, automate reporting.
description: Finance automation platform whose AI agents let teams query financial systems in natural language — no SQL required — and automate reporting workflows like flux analysis, AR aging, and revenue forecasting. It connects to ERPs (NetSuite, QuickBooks), data warehouses (Snowflake), and billing systems, and exports analysis in multiple formats.

modelSupport.notes: Natural-language analysis over connected financial systems.

edge: Purpose-built for FP&A: agents query live financials across ERP, warehouse, and billing in one place, where general BI tools stop at dashboards.
cons: Value depends on clean data sources
